llm_response.reason: The site poses as an authorized retailer for 'Ariat International,' but uses an unrelated domain not connected to the official brand. It displays reassurance phrases ('100% Secure Shopping,' 'Free Shipping Over $60'), lacks clear company details, and provides no business-level contact info. External reports across YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook reference undelivered orders, fake discounts, refusal of refunds, and no real customer service. These fit multiple scam website characteristics: spoofing legitimate companies, unusually low prices and free offers, ambiguous privacy information, handling a range of branded goods at excessive discounts, and extensive consumer warnings.
